reviewedFunctionBodies.rationale: Admin broadcast payloads are bounded at the Edge Function and forwarded to an explicit platform-admin RPC.
Admin report moderation requests are mediated by an authenticated Edge Function before explicit admin RPC execution.
Admin invitation decisions are checked inside the Edge Function before invitation state changes are written.
Spotlight listing moderation updates are routed through an authenticated Edge Function with schema validation and platform-admin authorization.
Firesale moderation requests are authenticated at the Edge boundary before explicit platform-admin RPC execution.
Pricing configuration writes are schema-validated and admin-authorized inside the Edge Function before database mutation.
Agent data-input submissions and review actions are normalized at the Edge Function before storage or admin review RPCs.
AI search prompts are normalized and bounded by the Edge Function before provider calls are made.
Service matching requests are validated at the Edge boundary before AI and professional matching logic runs.
Translation requests are routed through an Edge Function so text size and provider payloads stay controlled.
Role-switch requests are mediated by the Edge Function so client payloads cannot directly grant privileges.
Onboarding role completion is an Edge-mediated mutation that keeps role assignment checks out of direct UI writes.
Professional onboarding setup writes are schema-validated and owner-checked inside the Edge Function before service, availability, or video settings mutate.
Checkout payloads are finalized by the Edge Function before Stripe session creation and billing redirects.
Investor payment link bodies are admin-authorized and converted server-side before bespoke Stripe Checkout sessions are created.
Stripe price creation is admin-authorized and schema-validated at the Edge boundary before external Stripe calls.
Portal action bodies are resolved by the Edge Function before Stripe customer portal or subscription resume operations run.
New-build project, unit, media, listing, and image creation is authenticated, developer-gated, schema-validated, and ownership-forced inside the Edge Function before database mutations.

Project, project listing cover, unit, media, and project lead mutations are authenticated, developer-gated, schema-validated, and project-owner checked inside the Edge Function before database writes.
Past-deal imports are constrained by the Edge Function and do not expose OS credentials to the browser.
OS report requests keep MAIProp OS credentials server-side, require caller auth, and normalize listing/report inputs before fetch and billing.
OS sync pagination and replacement options are interpreted server-side before database import work begins.
Invitation notification payloads are sent through the Edge boundary rather than browser-controlled email logic.
Listing AI prompts are centralized in the Edge Function so usage controls and prompt shaping remain server-side.
Role-switch audit events are written through the Edge Function to preserve a consistent audit boundary.
Neighbourhood report inputs are bounded by the Edge Function before AI generation and quota checks execute.
OS diagnostics use an empty body and are restricted to admin diagnostic connectivity checks.
Coordinate-based comparable-sales requests are bounded by the Edge Function before proxying to the MAIProp OS API.
Owner Pro status checks are resolved server-side so subscription state is not trusted from the browser.
Property point-of-interest requests are normalized server-side before external map and location lookups.
Valuation requests are centralized in the Edge Function for quota, input shape, and AI provider controls.
Bulk project unit price changes are authenticated at the Edge boundary and routed through an owner-scoped RPC.
Listing view events are written through an Edge Function to keep analytics writes consistent and bounded.
Smart filter requests are interpreted server-side so browser-provided property criteria remain bounded.
Firesale interest submissions are authenticated and validated inside the Edge Function before workflow writes.
Quick Sale request creation and rollback are authenticated, seller-gated, and schema-validated inside the Edge Function before firesale_requests is mutated.
Firesale OS sync requests are interpreted by the Edge Function before any OS or database mutation occurs.
Stripe price synchronization is admin-authorized and schema-validated before external Stripe reads and pricing upserts.
Listing OS sync requests are mediated by the Edge Function so browser payloads cannot reach OS credentials.
Platform admin transfer requests are routed through an Edge Function instead of direct privilege table writes.

reviewedDynamicInvocations.rationale: The admin function tester only exposes a fixed UI allowlist of OS diagnostic and sync functions.
